params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: sheet
params.description: Sheet index (current sheet if omitted); may also be one of the scope constants

sentinelValues.meaning: Remove the style sheet from the current sheet.
Remove the style sheet from the workbook level.

overloads.semanticRole: The VP REMOVE STYLESHEET command removes the style sheet passed in the styleName from the vpAreaName .

constraints: An error is returned if vpAreaName does not designate an existing 4D View Pro area.
